config.language.auto: Follow the IDE display language (Chinese → 中文, otherwise English)
config.language.desc: Language used by CodeLadder explanations and the panel. `auto` follows the IDE display language.
config.llm.baseUrl.desc: Fallback OpenAI-compatible API base URL (e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`). CodeLadder first tries a language model exposed by the IDE (`vscode.lm`); these settings are used only when none is available. Leave empty to use the deterministic project index only.
config.llm.apiKey.desc: API key for the fallback endpoint (stored in plain text; recommended for personal devices only).
